Class OfferTrack

java.lang.Object
model.board.OfferTrack
public class OfferTrack extends Object
Manages the offer track component of the board. The offer track is a sequence of tiles (labeled A through G) where players place their totems to perform actions. It tracks which tiles are occupied and provides queries for retrieving tiles and coordinating player actions.

    • OfferTrack

      public OfferTrack(List<OfferTile> tiles)
      Constructs an OfferTrack with a given list of tiles. The tiles are expected to be pre-filtered and ordered by the factory.
      Parameters:
      tiles - the ordered list of OfferTiles from A to G

  • Method Details

    • placeTotem

      public void placeTotem(Player player, OfferTile offerTile)
      Places a player's totem on a specific offer tile and updates the player's location. Sets the player's totem on the given tile and marks the player's location as being on the offer track.
      Parameters:
      player - the player whose totem is being placed
      offerTile - the target OfferTile where the totem will be placed
      See Also:
      • OfferTile.placeTotem(Player)
      • Player.setLocation(TotemLocation)

    • getTileByLetter

      public OfferTile getTileByLetter(char letter)
      Finds an offer tile by its letter identifier. Performs a linear search through the tiles to locate the one matching the given letter. Used to map client input (a letter) to the corresponding tile.
      Parameters:
      letter - the letter identifier of the tile to find (typically A-G)
      Returns:
      the OfferTile with the given letter, or null if not found

    • getTiles

      public List<OfferTile> getTiles()
      Returns all offer tiles on this track.
      Returns:
      a list of all OfferTiles in order (A to G)

    • getNextPlayer

      public Player getNextPlayer()
      Returns the first player encountered on any occupied tile in track order. This typically represents the next player whose action will be resolved.
      Returns:
      the Player occupying the first occupied tile, or null if no tiles are occupied

    • getOccupiedTileByPlayer

      public OfferTile getOccupiedTileByPlayer(Player player)
      Finds the offer tile occupied by a specific player.
      Parameters:
      player - the player to search for
      Returns:
      the OfferTile occupied by the player, or null if the player is not on the offer track

    • removeTotem

      public void removeTotem(Player player)
      Removes a player's totem from whichever offer tile they currently occupy. This operation is called at the end of a player's action turn before the totem is returned to the turn order tile. If the player is not on the offer track, this method performs no operation.
      Parameters:
      player - the player whose totem is to be removed
